flagged.item: A ranked window can omit an already settled contract
flagged.why: The published market snapshot omitted KXAAAGASD-26NOV21-3.6600 although the official per-ticker record reported finalized / no. A snapshot-only join left its archived alerts without a result and could leave a paper position open.
flagged.action: The collector follows alerted contracts and outstanding paper positions by ticker. It can use the historical partition after a live 404 and retains sourced final results. Failed or deferred lookups leave the status and result blank; the alert ledger labels them unverified.

flagged.item: Alert feed counts could exceed the number of published rows
flagged.why: With 302 in-scope swings and 301 model-watch matches in a regression fixture, both JSON feeds contained 300 rows but their counts still reported the larger totals. The validation mismatch would block a collector pass at that size.
flagged.action: Each feed now reports the number of rows it actually publishes. The archive and archive-wide evidence totals remain separate; no swing is dropped from the archive by the feed cap.

flagged.item: The executive summary used old counts as if they were current
flagged.why: The summary still called the 17:30 UTC snapshot current after the collector and the separate ROI scanner had produced newer files. The ROI scan and market snapshot also have different timestamps and coverage.
flagged.action: The summary reads each timestamp and count from its own published artifact. It labels the experimental alert filter separately from the fee-aware ROI scan. Missing metrics stay blank and are identified as unverified.

flagged.item: A failed no-commit collector run wrote a health record
flagged.why: The credential-free diagnostic run was dispatched with commit=false, but its validation failure still created a branch commit. The error annotation was sufficient for diagnosis.
flagged.action: Dry runs now leave Git unchanged even when a validator fails. Scheduled publishing runs still record health; the diagnostic commit was not included in the integration diff.
